answer: Require each agent identity to lock a non-refundable stake in a shared vault before it can attest or vote. Cost scales with network size: an attacker who needs many nodes to control a decision vertex must fund that many locks, so farmed clones become expensive. Peer graders then score challenge answers the way a sonnet is scored for structure—coherence of the proposed cost curve—so empty clones fail grading and never unlock standing.
